name: JirFine Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: JirFine Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of CNC machine tools in China and internationally. The company offers drilling and milling machining, vertical machining, gantry machining, and horizontal machining centers; and CNC lathes. It serves general equipment manufacturers, consumer electronics, automation, automotive parts, precision molds, aerospace, communications, mechanical parts processing, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
